Flag months beyond thresholds of a standardised index

Source: R/calc_std_index.R
calc_std_threshold.Rd

Flags, for every SPI or SPEI column registered by calc_std_index(), the months below or above each threshold, e.g. spi3_blw_-1.5 for a 3-month SPI below -1.5 (severe drought). The sign is kept in the name. The flags are registered, so calc_spell() finds drought spells and the window summaries count drought months. Replaces extr_std_index() of climatic4economist.

Usage

calc_std_threshold(
  x,
  above = NULL,
  below = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  chunk = "auto"
)

Arguments

x

A long table from calc_std_index().

above, below

Thresholds on the index, e.g. below = c(-1, -1.5, -2).

id

Optional name of the unit identifier column.

label

Optional name shown in progress messages.

chunk

"auto" splits the work by unit when it would not fit in memory; a whole number forces that many units per chunk; FALSE never splits.

Value

x with one logical column per index column and threshold.

See also

Other indicators: calc_condition(), calc_heatwave(), calc_par(), calc_percentile(), calc_percentile_day(), calc_spell(), calc_spell_excess(), calc_spell_percentile(), calc_std_index(), calc_threshold_day()

Examples

pre <- read_climate(
  system.file("extdata", "pre_monthly.tif", package = "c4e"))
#> Read pre_monthly: pre [mm/month], monthly, 1984-01-01 to 2023-12-01, 480 layers
#> (synthetic).
survey <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "survey.csv", package = "c4e"))
coord <- prepare_coord(survey, lat_var = lat, lon_var = lon)
points <- georef_coord(coord, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

extract_by_coord(pre, points) |>
  calc_std_index(scale = 3) |>
  calc_std_threshold(below = c(-1, -1.5, -2))
